title: Access
description: Sessions, HTTP users and WAF tokens saved to inspect sites that need access. Only their general data is shown here, never their content.
storageWindows: They are stored encrypted and can only be opened by this Windows user on this computer (DPAPI). On another computer, or with another user, you have to sign in again.
storageOther: They are stored encrypted with a key protected by this user's system keychain. On another computer you have to sign in again.
noneBody: When an inspection finds a sign-in, a cookie banner or an anti-bot check, it will offer to open a window to resolve it; the access will be saved here.
expiredValue: expired: the last inspection found the sign-in
robots: This site is mine: also inspect what robots.txt excludes —
unsafeLinks: Links that are never visited, besides the usual ones:
openWindow: Open a window to sign in
windowHelp: A visible window opens on this computer. You sign in; EXEGEZIS does not type or store your password, only the cookies of that site and its subdomains.

form.httpHelp: Stored encrypted on this computer (only this Windows user can open them) and only sent to this site. They never appear in reports or logs.
form.wafHelp: Only for a site of yours. EXEGEZIS generates a secret, stores it encrypted and sends it as the <header></header> header to this site only. You create a WAF rule that lets requests with that secret through.
form.rotate: There is already a token: create a new one (the previous one will stop working)
form.showSteps: Show the steps with the token
form.tokenFor: Token for {origin} (shown now; keep it like a password):
form.step3: Action: <skip></skip>, and tick Bot Fight Mode / Super Bot Fight Mode, Managed Challenge and the rate limiting rules. Save the rule.
form.step4: Inspect the site again. On Vercel it is the same: Firewall → Custom rules, the same condition on the header, action Bypass.

errors.confirmPermission: Confirm that the site is yours or that you are allowed to inspect it.
errors.userPassword: Type the username and the password.
errors.savedFor: Saved for {origin}. The next inspections of this site will authenticate as {username}.
errors.tokenFailed: The token could not be created: {detail}
errors.originalMissing: The original inspection was not found.

HTTP_AUTH.title: The site asks for a username and password (HTTP authentication)
HTTP_AUTH.explanation: The server answers 401 and asks for HTTP credentials (Basic or Digest). Type that site's username and password: they are stored encrypted on this computer and only sent to that site.

BOT_CHALLENGE.title: The site shows an anti-bot check
BOT_CHALLENGE.explanation: There is an anti-bot challenge (Cloudflare, Turnstile, reCAPTCHA, hCaptcha, DataDome…). EXEGEZIS never solves or bypasses it. If the site is yours, the recommended way is to authorize EXEGEZIS in its WAF with a token; otherwise you can pass the check yourself in a window (only on your own site or with permission).
BOT_CHALLENGE.window: Pass the check in a window

SESSION_EXPIRED.title: The saved session has expired
SESSION_EXPIRED.explanation: There was a saved session, but the site asks to sign in again. Renew it in a window: the inspection is relaunched on its own with the same options.

LOGIN_WALL.title: You need to sign in to see this page
LOGIN_WALL.explanation: The requested page redirects to the sign-in or only shows a login form. Sign in yourself in a window: EXEGEZIS only keeps this site's cookies, never your password.
LOGIN_WALL.window: Open a window to sign in

CONSENT_WALL.title: A cookie banner covers the content
CONSENT_WALL.explanation: A cookie dialog covers the page and blocks navigation. Choose yourself in a window (the most private option works); the choice is remembered. The inspection never clicks the banner.

RATE_LIMITED.title: The site asks to slow down
RATE_LIMITED.explanation: The site answered 429 (or 503 with Retry-After). EXEGEZIS waited as asked and slowed down, but the waiting cap was exceeded.

FORBIDDEN.title: The site rejects this computer
FORBIDDEN.explanation: 403 response without a challenge: the site rejects this IP, this country or a rule of its WAF. Retrying does not help. If the site is yours, allow-list this IP or authorize EXEGEZIS with a WAF token.

NETWORK_RESTRICTED.title: The site is not reachable from this network
NETWORK_RESTRICTED.explanation: The name does not resolve or the address is private: the site is only reachable from a VPN, an intranet or a private DNS. Connect to that network and try again.

notice.noConclusion: No conclusion was drawn about the site: a block never produces findings.
notice.permission: This site is mine or I am allowed to inspect it. If the challenge appears again, EXEGEZIS stops: it never retries against it.
notice.windowHelp: A visible window opens on this computer. You do the step; EXEGEZIS does not type or store your password, only this site's cookies.
notice.windowRelaunch: When you finish, the inspection is relaunched on its own.
notice.wafSummary: Own site: authorize EXEGEZIS in the WAF (recommended)
